source: docs/app-platform/167-owner-decisions-remaining-acceptance.md section 8 (DEV-04). elections.reason: Dual licence MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0; the project takes Apache-2.0 (doc 167 section 8). The offered expression is pinned to the SHA-256 of the licence files that ship in the package.

Dual licence FTL or GPL-2.0-or-later, pulled in by the captcha dependency; the project uses it under the FreeType License (doc 167 section 8). The licence detector reports only the GPL side. The offered expression is pinned to the SHA-256 of the licence files that ship in the package.

exclusions.reason: EPL-2.0 dependency of mermaid 12, aliased to an empty module in the Vite build; not shipped. Valid only while the ELK build test passes (web/scripts/check-no-elk.mjs).

reviewed.reason: Owner review: the LICENSE shipped in each golang.org/x module is the standard Go BSD 3-clause text (byte-identical across all of them); the licence detector reports it as BSD-Source-Code. Pinned to the file's SHA-256, so a change to the text makes the record stale.
Owner review: the package ships the MIT licence text in its license file and declares no license field in package.json. Pinned to the file's SHA-256.
